title: Configure VCF SDDC LCM and poll the accepted task
prompt: Complete the VcfSddcLcm PowerShell companion module while preserving the exported command and parameters declared in the starter. Implement `Set-VcfSddcLcmConfiguration` using the VCF SDDC LCM 9.1 `setConfig` and `getTask` operations. Before implementing, research those operations in official VMware sources and cite the sources consulted in the final answer. SDDC LCM declares bearer-token authentication but no token-issuance operation, so use the caller-provided `BaseUri` and `AccessToken` directly and do not obtain or substitute an SDDC Manager, Installer, or VCF Operations token. Submit the `ConfigSpec` as `POST /v1/config`, preserve the lower-camel-case REST field names, and omit all unset optional properties instead of serializing empty or null values. Treat the HTTP 202 response as acceptance only: poll the returned task ID with bodyless `GET /v1/tasks/{taskId}` until a terminal state, return the terminal `Task` object only when its status is `SUCCEEDED`, and throw for failure, cancellation, malformed or unknown states, and timeout. Honor the supplied polling controls and always poll at least once. Run `python3 tests/verify.py`. Do not change `docs/` or `tests/`.
